lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gills, arranged in approximately seven distinct vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs, forming a lattice-like pattern where the blobs serve as nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately twelve distinct high-luminance blobs of varying sizes, with higher spatial density located towards the trailing edge of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense, randomized pattern of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary flank constellations.
